course.title: SQL Mastery
course.description: Ready to dive into SQL and databases? In our practical, beginner-friendly course, you'll learn how to efficiently manage and manipulate data using SQL. Understand database structures, queries, and advanced techniques to interact with relational databases. Whether you're building data-driven applications or analyzing data, this course will equip you with the skills to work confidently with SQL and databases. By the end, you'll be prepared to tackle any database challenge with ease.

instructor.name: Abdillahi Haji
instructor.description: A skilled database engineer with years of experience in managing complex database systems. Abdillahi specializes in teaching SQL with a focus on practical applications and efficiency.

course.title: Node & Express
course.description: Looking to master Node.js and Express? Our comprehensive course will teach you how to build fast, scalable server-side applications using these powerful technologies. Dive into JavaScript on the backend and discover how Express simplifies routing and middleware. You'll learn how to create robust APIs, connect to databases, and handle user authentication. With hands-on exercises, you'll gain the practical experience needed to develop production-ready web apps with Node.js and Express. Start building your backend skills today!

instructor.name: Fatima Mouse
instructor.description: A backend developer with a deep understanding of Node.js and Express. Fatima excels at breaking down complex concepts and guiding students through building scalable backend solutions.

course.title: Dart & Flutter
course.description: Excited to learn Dart and Flutter? This course will guide you through the process of creating beautiful, high-performance apps for mobile, web, and desktop. With Dart as your programming language and Flutter for building UIs, you'll learn how to develop apps that run seamlessly across platforms. From designing intuitive interfaces to connecting with databases and APIs, you’ll gain a deep understanding of app development. By the end of the course, you'll be able to build and deploy real-world applications, ready to wow users with your skills.

instructor.name: Mahdi Moalim
instructor.description: An accomplished mobile developer with a knack for creating cross-platform apps. Mahdi is dedicated to teaching Dart and Flutter with a focus on real-world development.
